mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) consistently signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as measured by the level of the policy rate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% (UNRATE) signals economic weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated corporate earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230) signals stagflation risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate central bank tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL > 230

mechanism_narrative: During labor market recovery (defined by PAYEMS rising >0.5% MoM and UNRATE falling >0.2pp MoM), S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates with stronger consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE < -0.2pp MoM

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST > 1000) signals robust consumer demand and economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as housing strength correlates with broader economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1000

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO > 100) signals strong supply capacity and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as manufacturing expansion supports corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in non-farm payrolls above 200,000 jobs (PAYEMS > 200) signals strong labor market conditions that drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as hiring supports consumer spending and earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 200

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong housing starts (HOUST > 1000) and rising retail sales (RSAFS > 400000) signals robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as spending growth accelerates economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS > 400000
